responsibility: Declares the small runtime exception-reporting interface used by GNU Modula-2 generated code for `CASE` failure and missing `RETURN` diagnostics. It is the public header for the fatal runtime helpers implemented in `Gmcrts.cc`.
same_name_distinction: This is the header side of the Gmcrts pair: it declares the runtime exception-reporting functions used by generated code, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gmcrts.cc contains the actual stderr-reporting and process-termination behavior.
